title: UX Copy Structure Compiler
description: Validates copy structure specs: unique content slot ids, typed placeholders with examples, state coverage completeness, character limits on primary slots, i18n interpolation consistency, and experiment variant references. Produces copy-structure-artifact.json.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract copy-structure-spec.json from feature brief and content inventory

pipeline.title: Structure
pipeline.description: Validate spec shape and unique slot ids

pipeline.title: Quality
pipeline.description: Validate placeholder typing, state coverage, and character limits

pipeline.title: i18n
pipeline.description: Validate i18n interpolation and experiment variant references

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: copy-structure-spec.json exists with content_slots array, each slot has id, screen, priority

gates.title: Unique Content IDs
gates.description: All slot ids are unique across the entire spec

gates.title: Placeholder Typed
gates.description: Every placeholder is an object with key, type, and example — no bare strings

gates.title: State Coverage
gates.description: Every stateCoverage entry has a valid state and content or inherit declaration

gates.title: Char Limits
gates.description: All primary slots declare charLimit (positive number)

gates.title: i18n Interpolation
gates.description: All {{key}} and {key} placeholders in content strings have declared placeholder entries

gates.title: Variant References
gates.description: Slots with experimentVariant must have a non-empty variantId (null is explicit opt-out)

gates.title: Copy Structure Contract
gates.description: Version, feature_id or id, screen reference on each slot

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled copy structure specs

error_codes.UCS001: copy-structure-spec.json missing or invalid — content_slots with id, screen, priority required
error_codes.UCS002: Duplicate slot id found across content_slots
error_codes.UCS003: Placeholder is a bare string or missing key/type/example fields
error_codes.UCS004: stateCoverage entry missing valid state or content/inherit declaration
error_codes.UCS005: Primary slot missing charLimit — primary content needs a character budget
error_codes.UCS006: Content string uses placeholder key not declared in slot.placeholders
error_codes.UCS007: experimentVariant declared without a non-empty variantId
error_codes.UCS008: Copy structure contract violation — version, identifier, or screen reference missing
